standard_prerequisites: the WAdm^Noeth category, localizations A_{f} and their completions A_{f} bracket, and naive rig-flatness on rig-closed primes
Jacobson rings and permanence under finite type quotients
the rig-closed prime lifting lemmas under localization and contraction
the local criterion for flatness with the generating condition on primes
finite inclusions of local rings and units
core_obligations: Prove that if A/I is Jacobson for some ideal of definition I and the arrow phi : A to B is naively rig-flat, then phi is rig-flat
proof_roadmap: Record the permanence facts: the localizations at f and their completions stay Noetherian adic, the maps are adic topologically finite type and flat, and the I-quotients remain Jacobson
Naive rig-flatness gives flatness at rig-closed primes of B; it suffices to prove flatness of (B_{f}bracket) at every rig-closed q' over A_{f}bracket
The rig-closed lifting lemma shows the contractions q in B, p' in A_{f}bracket and p in A are all rig-closed

Apply the local criterion for flatness to B_q over A_p base-changed to (A_{f})_{p'}: the remaining assumption that p generates the maximal ideal follows because rig-closedness makes A/p to A_{f}/p' a finite inclusion of local rings in which f is a unit, the step that fails without the Jacobson hypothesis
difficulty_reason: H2: a reduction through localizations to the local criterion for flatness, with the Jacobson-specific unit argument isolated by the source itself.
